items.title: Dave Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Wilton, Connecticut, November 21, 2001
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think, didn’t Mel Torme and his partner write “The Christmas Song” in the middle of July too, sitting by a swimming pool? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah. See that’s how things happen. You don’t plan them. And a lot of times you don’t plan and it just happens.
I think, didn’t Mel Torme and his partner write “The Christmas Song” in the middle of July too, sitting by a swimming pool?
